messages:
jen: Heads-up — monitoring alerted an uptick in 5xx from api.v1/logs. I have a tiny patch that tightens a null-check. Low-risk but customer-facing. This is in the surge window tonight (22:00-02:00). Do we allow a patch deploy during surge? If yes, semver question: bump patch (v1.14.3) or use a hotfix pre-release tag? Also deploy-bot normally blocks surge — who can grant an emergency override? :eyes:

deploy-bot: preflight checks: CI ✅, unit/integration ✅, canary tests pending. surge-window policy: BLOCK (auto-deploy disabled). To override set `deploybot.override=emergency` AND get 2 approvers from release/sre teams. See: https://redwood.internal/runbook/deploybot#surge-window

sam: It's a patch, not a minor. We should avoid any minor bump. My preference: patch only. Create a PR labelled `emergency-patch` and tag it `hotfix` pre-release so rollforward logic is clear. Sam+Katy can approve for emergency overrides.

katy: Agree with patch. Prefer a semver pre-release suffix instead of buildmeta: `v1.14.3-hotfix.0` — keeps sorting and rollbacks sane. Proposed rollout: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with auto-rollback threshold = error rate >1.5% over a 3m window. Also add a one-line release note.

mike: Frontend change is just header parsing; low risk. I'll open the PR now and add the `emergency-patch` label.

jen: OK thanks. Sam/Katy — will you two approve once PR is up? Also want to confirm deploy-bot command/format to push tag.

deploy-bot: Example tag workflow (approved override required):
```
# create annotated pre-release tag
git tag -a v1.14.3-hotfix.0 -m "hotfix: tighten null-check for api.v1/logs"
git push origin v1.14.3-hotfix.0
# to trigger deploy with override (after 2 approvers)
./deploybot trigger --tag v1.14.3-hotfix.0 --override emergency
```
Note: using build metadata (e.g. `v1.14.3+hotfix1`) is discouraged for rollforward/selection logic. Pre-release suffix (`-hotfix.x`) is preferred.

sam: Approving on the PR now. Also add rollback steps to the PR description: revert tag + run `./ops/rollback-to v1.14.2` and follow rollback-playbook (traffic shift + traceroute check).

katy: I'll be on watch during rollout. If error rate >1.5% sustained over 3m, I'll trigger rollback. I'll post in #incidents if I flip it. :eyes: :hammer_and_wrench:

jen: Plan summary: Mike opens PR with `emergency-patch` label, tag as `v1.14.3-hotfix.0`, Sam+Katy approve, deploy-bot override with `emergency` after approvals, canary 5% -> 25% -> full, auto-rollback at 1.5% over 3m. I'll add release note and link to PR in release doc. Thanks — Mike, ping here when PR is up. :shipit:
